findings.title: Public helpers removed from mark_failed module without compatibility shims
findings.body: This diff deletes `SimpleCheckIn`, `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason` and `get_monitor_environment_context` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, and renames `create_issue_platform_occurrence` to `create_incident_occurrence` in a new module. Any existing import or `mock.patch` target that uses the old module path (for example `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` or `mark_failed.SimpleCheckIn`) will now raise ImportError or silently patch nothing. The PR does not show a search of the codebase and tests for those references, nor updates to them.

findings.body: The docstring of `get_failure_reason` says 'Builds a humam readible string'. Since this function is being moved into a new module, it is a good moment to fix the spelling to 'human readable'.
